review.rationale: Primary review of the 27 ECE-tagged cards on the official UConn College of Engineering people directory (the department site's faculty button links to this directory), reconciled with a full-roster independent Haiku audit that enumerated all ECE-named cards on the page. 23 regular faculty are included and 4 staff excluded. Limit: the directory publishes no ECE emeritus, adjunct, lecturer, joint or affiliated category, so coverage of those excluded or secondary roles is not established.
